questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] In terms of pH, what is ammonia (NH₃)?
A. Acidic
B. Basic
C. Neutral
Answer: B. Ammonia is a basic substance. When dissolved in water, it forms ammonium hydroxide, which is a weak base with a pH greater than 7.
questions.de: Ammoniak (NH₃) bildet in Wasser gelöst welche schwache Base mit einem pH-Wert über 7?
questions.en: Ammonia (NH₃) dissolved in water forms which weak base, with a pH greater than 7?

timeline.labelEn: Joseph Priestley isolates ammonia gas, calling it 'alkaline air'
timeline.labelDe: Joseph Priestley isoliert gasförmiges Ammoniak und nennt es „alkalische Luft“

questions.notes: Acidic/basic/neutral MC turned into the explanation's fact. Ammonia solution = ammonia water = ammonium hydroxide; a 1 M solution has pH ≈ 11.6. Strictly only ~0.4% exists as NH4+ / OH− (no isolable NH4OH). Timeline from the Ammonia article.

questions.cardText:
[Physics] What is “dark matter”?
A. A theoretical substance that emits light so faintly that always appears as dark in observations
B. A type of matter that does not emit or interact with electromagnetic radiation
C. The matter found in the core of stars
Answer: B. Because dark matter is difficult to observe, researchers can only infer its presence through its gravitational effects on other more directly observable matters.
questions.de: Wie heißt die hypothetische Form von Materie, die keine elektromagnetische Strahlung aussendet oder mit ihr wechselwirkt und nur über ihre Gravitationswirkung erschlossen wird?
questions.en: What is the name for the hypothetical form of matter that does not emit or interact with electromagnetic radiation and is inferred only from its gravitational effects?

timeline.labelEn: Fritz Zwicky infers unseen 'dark matter' from galaxy motions in the Coma Cluster
timeline.labelDe: Fritz Zwicky erschließt aus Galaxienbewegungen im Coma-Haufen unsichtbare „Dunkle Materie“

questions.notes: Definition question reversed so the answer is the term.
